title: ACIS carrier generation, FreeCAD consumer limits, and DWG AcDs controls
mode: Deeper/broader primary-source web research and local plan reconciliation; research only
head: de27a3391a624aba03ca71f3583c4b3a6e6396a9
scope: Reconcile stock FreeCAD DXF/DWG importer limits with its optional ACIS-capable add-on route.
Identify reproducible scratch-generation possibilities and limits for SAT/SAB DXF carriers.
Turn the LibreDWG AcDs generated issue report into a guarded peer-comparison protocol without treating it as a libdxfrw finding.
Keep J256, J260, J268, J284, J293, and J295 external-only and non-promoting.

sources.revision: Mutable FreeCAD documentation and main source reviewed 2026-10-19
sources.observed: The Draft DXF guide says stock import cannot read ACIS/SAT solid payloads. Its documented C++ and legacy Python importer entity sets differ; the legacy path includes 3DFACE. importDWG.py invokes external DWG converters and then sends DXF through the regular DXF importer; current ODA route requests ACAD2000 DXF.

sources.revision: Mutable master README and importer source reviewed 2026-10-19
sources.observed: The DXF adapter uses ezdxf to extract SAT/SAB and a custom AcisReader, then offers native or STEP import. The add-on README lists unsupported ACIS features. This is a distinct parser route, but shape construction still occurs through FreeCAD/OCCT and is not a distinct kernel-family oracle.

The package supports simple/known ACIS structures, is not an ACIS kernel, warns unsupported records become NONE_ENTITY and arbitrary ACIS cannot be round-tripped, and can generate polyhedral ACIS bodies from meshes. Documentation maps SAT to DXF R2000-R2010 and SAB to R2013/R2018; mesh extraction only represents flat polygonal faces.

sources.project: LibreDWG AcDs report and implementation references
sources.revision: Issue #1411 names LibreDWG 0.14.8593 at source 8a1ae764; manual, NEWS and decoder links are mutable master pages reviewed 2026-10-19
sources.observed: Issue #1411 describes an ezdxf-generated AC1032 DXF REGION with a cube-derived SAB body and reports its loss through a named LibreDWG DXF→DWG→DXF route; it is not independently reproduced here. Current NEWS describes incomplete AcDsPrototype_1b support and brute-force extraction for some SAB blobs, while current decoder source contains an AcDs reader, so exact version/build and direction must be pinned.

localEvidence: The existing plan already separates codec conversion, FreeCAD orchestration, DXF import, ACIS payload preservation, and semantic/native acceptance.
Stock FreeCAD's documented ACIS limitation makes it inapplicable as a 3DSOLID/REGION B-rep oracle; this does not reduce its usefulness for supported 2D or explicit-entity routes.
ezdxf offers a from-scratch polyhedral SAT/SAB generation route suitable for bounded scratch controls, not general ACIS correctness.
No peer report or public support statement was reproduced as a libdxfrw result.

assessment.planImpact: Separates stock FreeCAD explicit-entity import evidence from optional add-on SAT/SAB parsing; defines a pinned scratch-generated polyhedral carrier profile and AcDs precondition checks for the one composed peer gate. No support claim, finding, implementation order, routine validation cost, dependency, or fixture status changes.

method.kind: Primary-source documentation, repository source and issue-report review; local plan crosswalk
method.limitations: FreeCAD and LibreDWG main/master pages are mutable. InventorLoader is an optional add-on with its own limitations and uses the FreeCAD/OCCT kernel family. ezdxf explicitly limits its ACIS model to simple/known structures and does not provide a geometry kernel. LibreDWG issue #1411 is a reporter account and was not reproduced. No evidence here closes external qualification gates.

implementationReadyChecks: At the composed FreeCAD gate, capture the importer backend and record stock-importer ACIS payloads as UNSUPPORTED_CONSUMER rather than codec failures or solid support.
If InventorLoader is used, pin its revision, FreeCAD/OCCT, ezdxf package, native-versus-STEP strategy, source payload, parser disposition, and known unsupported features.

Generate only a scratch asymmetric polyhedral ACIS control from a pinned ezdxf package; distinguish SAT AC1015/AC1018/AC1021/AC1024 from SAB AC1027/AC1032 and record exact carrier bytes and unsupported records.

Before a DWG AcDs comparison, prove the generated source DXF produced the expected AcDs section and entity-owner/key graph in the intermediate DWG; then test DXF AcDs records and joins after conversion.
Keep scratch artifacts outside the repository, do not add production/test dependencies, and run peer/native checks only at the existing composed checkpoint—not for every local slice.
J256, J260, J268, J284, J293, and J295 remain DEFERRED_EXTERNAL and non-promoting.
